generalAbilities.name: Bonded Theater
generalAbilities.description: A theater phantasm can't travel more than 50 feet from the theater (or similar location) where it was created.

generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 100 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

hp.note: emotional consumption, dramatic return, void healing

defensiveAbilities.name: All-Around Vision
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster can see in all directions simultaneously and therefore can't be flanked.

defensiveAbilities.name: Catharsis
defensiveAbilities.description: When a theater phantasm is destroyed, it emits waves of emotional energy. All creatures within 50 feet take 10d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 34 Will Saving Throw) as they experience a crushing barrage of emotions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Dramatic Return
defensiveAbilities.description: A destroyed theater phantasm slowly reforms to full strength over the course of 1 week. The only way to permanently destroy the phantasm is to reduce it to 0 Hit Points during a performance occurring in its bonded theater.

defensiveAbilities.name: Emotional Consumption
defensiveAbilities.description: If a theater phantasm is within 100 feet of an audience of 20 or more intelligent beings witnessing a performance in its bonded theater, it gains fast healing 20.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spotlight
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The theater phantasm draws attention to a creature it admires. The phantasm designates a target other than itself within 50 feet with a subtle spotlight, giving the target a +2 status bonus to Performance checks and resistance 10 to mental damage for 1 minute. If it uses this ability again on a new target, the former creature loses its spotlight.

Effect: Spotlight
